title: skillopt: FlashRSI policy port
note: Delayed platform-measured study-feedback port; not native reproduction. See methods/flashrsi_ports/README.md for per-method mechanisms and differences.

preserved: Separate success/failure reflection, cross-source merge and bounded edit ranking.
Exact append/replace/delete/insert_after fast patches protect the SLOW_UPDATE region; slow guidance rewrites that region and carries optimizer meta-memory.
adapted: Platform measures candidates between external-method calls; only adaptation-visible study channel is read.
Candidate trees are staged artifacts; historical parents are restored from platform states.
missing_until_runtime_support: Native within-call evaluator callbacks and separate dev capability; no held-out score or gold exposure.
Strict selection uses full-set study fitness rather than separate dev score; fixed platform measurements replace fresh training minibatches and adjacent-epoch resampling.
Port epoch_batches schedules slow updates between method invocations; it is not a reproduction of native task-stream epochs.
Prompt JSON protocol is adapted while exact edit semantics and protected sections are implemented locally.

deviations.what: Method evaluation callbacks are replaced by delayed platform measurements.
deviations.why: INTERFACE.md §4 prohibits a method from evaluating benchmark tasks. The bridge reads only staged study records and returns whole candidates; it never invents a dev fitness or evaluates a held-out task.
